SELECT CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'prior' WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' THEN 'curr' ELSE 'other' END AS per,
 channel_code, channel_id, staff_purchase_flag,
 count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS n_rl,
 sum(net_amount) AS net, sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS qty_nonpos,
 min(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads,
 sum(CASE WHEN store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nostore
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH f AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'prior' WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' THEN 'curr' END AS per,
  s.store_id, coalesce(channel_id, CASE channel_code WHEN 'ST' THEN 1 WHEN 'WB' THEN 2 END) AS ch, staff_purchase_flag, net_amount
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
), r AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'prior' WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' THEN 'curr' END AS per,
  sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_before, sum(returns_net) AS rpt_ret, sum(net_sales) AS rpt_net, count(*) AS rpt_rows, count(DISTINCT store_id) AS rpt_stores, max(store_id) AS rpt_maxstore
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT f.per, f.ch, CASE WHEN f.store_id>=900 THEN f.store_id ELSE 0 END AS sid_class, sum(net_amount) AS net_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) AS net_nostaff, count(*) AS n,
 any_value(r.rpt_before), any_value(r.rpt_ret), any_value(r.rpt_net), any_value(r.rpt_stores), any_value(r.rpt_maxstore)
FROM f JOIN r USING (per) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH f AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date AS d, s.store_id, sum(net_amount) AS all_net, sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) AS nostaff, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS rc
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND (sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25') GROUP BY 1,2),
rt AS (SELECT r.return_date AS d, s.store_id, sum(refund_net) AS ret FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT count(*) AS days, sum(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(f.all_net,0)-p.net_sales_before_returns)<0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_all,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(f.nostaff,0)-p.net_sales_before_returns)<0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_nostaff,
 sum(CASE WHEN p.receipts=f.rc THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rc_match,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(rt.ret,0)-p.returns_net)<0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ret_match,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.d IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rpt_only,
 sum(p.net_sales_before_returns)-sum(f.all_net) AS diff_all, sum(p.returns_net)-sum(coalesce(rt.ret,0)) AS diff_ret
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales p LEFT JOIN f ON f.d=p.business_date AND f.store_id=p.store_id LEFT JOIN rt ON rt.d=p.business_date AND rt.store_id=p.store_id
WHERE p.store_id<900 AND (p.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR p.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25')

WITH cur AS (SELECT store_id, store_name, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id<900),
s AS (SELECT CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'p' ELSE 'c' END AS per, st.store_id, sale_date, net_amount AS amt
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE st.store_id<900 AND (sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25')),
r AS (SELECT CASE WHEN return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'p' ELSE 'c' END AS per, st.store_id, return_date AS sale_date, -refund_net AS amt
 FROM fact_return_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE st.store_id<900 AND (return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25')),
u AS (SELECT * FROM s UNION ALL SELECT * FROM r)
SELECT cur.store_id, cur.store_name, cur.region,
 round(sum(CASE WHEN per='p' THEN amt END),2) AS prior_net, round(sum(CASE WHEN per='c' THEN amt END),2) AS curr_net,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN per='p' THEN sale_date END) AS p_days, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN per='c' THEN sale_date END) AS c_days,
 min(CASE WHEN per='c' THEN sale_date END) AS c_first, max(CASE WHEN per='c' THEN sale_date END) AS c_last,
 min(CASE WHEN per='p' THEN sale_date END) AS p_first, max(CASE WHEN per='p' THEN sale_date END) AS p_last
FROM cur LEFT JOIN u USING (store_id) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 3,1

WITH lfl_store AS (
  -- like-for-like stores: physical stores open before 2024 (open_date null), current region mapping applied to both years
  SELECT store_id, region FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900 AND open_date IS NULL
),
period_lines AS (
  -- net sales lines (excluding VAT, after line discounts), staff purchases included as in rpt_daily_store_sales
  SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'prior' ELSE 'current' END AS period,
         st.store_id, f.net_amount AS amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
  UNION ALL
  -- refunds booked in the same periods, at the store where the return was made (web returns sit on store 900 and drop out)
  SELECT CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' THEN 'prior' ELSE 'current' END,
         st.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-01-26' OR r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-27' AND DATE '2026-01-25'
)
SELECT l.region,
       round((sum(CASE WHEN p.period = 'current' THEN p.amount END) / sum(CASE WHEN p.period = 'prior' THEN p.amount END) - 1) * 100, 2) AS lfl_growth_pct,
       count(DISTINCT l.store_id) AS stores,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN p.period = 'prior' THEN p.amount END), 2) AS prior_net, round(sum(CASE WHEN p.period = 'current' THEN p.amount END), 2) AS current_net
FROM period_lines p JOIN lfl_store l USING (store_id)
GROUP BY l.region ORDER BY l.region
